item.title: SUPER BOWL: Former Meyers, NFL star Qadry Ismail breaks down the game
item.description: Former Wilkes-Barre Meyers High School star Qadry Ismail is the only player from the Wyoming Valley to win a Super Bowl. He won his ring with the Baltimore Ravens in Super Bowl XXXV when they defeated the New York Giants, 34-7, in Tampa. Ismail also played for the Minnesota Vikings, Miami Dolphins, New Orleans Saints and Indianapolis Colts. He works as a Baltimore Ravens gameday analyst for WJZ in Baltimore. item.title: When patients in hospice, who cares for their pets?
item.description: Hospice patients sometimes spend their last days wondering what will become of their pet. Allied Services Hospice & Palliative Care Pet Peace of Mind program eases that burden.

item.title: Carl P. Leubsdorf: Texas election surprise could signal future GOP problem
item.description: The two Republicans who ought to worry the most about last weekend’s unexpected Democratic victory in a special Texas legislative election are John Cornyn and Ken Paxton.

item.title: WBS PENGUINS: Howe returns from ACL tear
item.description: When Tanner Howe tore his ACL last spring during the Western Hockey League’s playoffs, the subsequent surgery meant making his professional debut this season would be put on hold. item.title: Bill and Debbie Dennis celebrating wedding anniversary
item.description: Bill and Debbie Dennis are celebrating their 23rd wedding anniversary. They were married in Plymouth on Feb. 8, 2003. Their attendants were Heather Coleman, Renee Coleman, Fred Dourand, Kurt Tobin, Sean Fenner, Fred Dourand Jr., Karissa Dennis and Alesha Dennis. Bill is employed by RK HydroVac. Debbie is director of Shared Ride. They have two daughters, Karissa and Madison.

item.title: The Optimist: One big Super Blur
item.description: If it hadn’t turned into the John Riggins Bowl, 1972’s Super Bowl XVII may have been called the Jimmy Cefalo Bowl. Riggins led Washington to a 27-17 victory over Cefalo’s Dolphins.
